\section{Validation of This Thesis's Own Checks}
\label{sup:s5}

This section will report whether the checks this thesis relies on elsewhere
actually work: whether they fire on a known defect and stay quiet on a clean
run, whether a positive control at this project's own evaluation size
behaves the way the instrument's power curve says it should, and whether a
sweep run in public replicates the identity it is supposed to satisfy at
every cell rather than only in aggregate. None of that is reported here yet.
